scenarios.desc: Score one source file on the five qualities
scenarios.input: Assess maintainability of src/services/auth.py. I want cohesion, coupling, encapsulation, testability and non-redundancy scored, with remediation guidance for the low ones. Tell me the exact command you would run. Answer in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: SKILL.md Quick Start and Scripts table name scripts/assess.py --target <path> --format markdown and the five qualities. A generic answer would not name the script or its flags.

scenarios.desc: CI gate on changed files that must not block on inherited debt
scenarios.input: I want a CI check that tells me whether my branch made code quality worse versus origin/main, without failing on old debt. How do I run the code qualities assessment for that, and what do the nonzero exit codes mean? Answer in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: Gate Modes and Exit Codes sections: regression mode needs --changed-only and --base, exit 10 means regressed, exit 11 means below thresholds. The Anti-Patterns table says not to block merges on absolute scores.

scenarios.desc: Exit 10 after adding a few small functions
scenarios.input: assess.py exited 10 on my PR after I added three small helper functions and about 100 lines to one module. Cohesion dropped from 8.7 to about 7. Is that real decay, and how should I read it? Answer in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: Gate Modes section explains cohesion is 10 - LOC/120 - 0.3 * (definitions - 1) at confidence 0.4, so growth costs about 1.7 points and the heuristic cannot tell growth from decay. Default --regression-tolerance is 0.5.

scenarios.desc: Run risk-scoped pre-merge review on a docs-only branch (negative)
scenarios.input: Run a pre-merge review of my docs-only PR that edits README.md and docs/getting-started.md, checking spec compliance and documentation accuracy for a merge verdict. Answer in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: The description says Do NOT use for a full pre-merge review (use review), and on a docs-only PR risk-scoped review skips code-qualities-assessment because no source files changed.

scenarios.input: Grade every domain in the repository A through F (agents, skills, scripts, tests, docs, workflows) and show me the trend since last quarter. Answer in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: The description says Do NOT use for repo-wide domain grading (use quality-grades). This skill scores maintainability of specific code, not domains.
